title: In-Effect!
description: Add permanent vanilla or modded effects to players! Util for modpacks.
body:
# <center> ABOUT: </center>

Add infinite and permanent effects to players with easy config that updates in real time. Also, you can use effects from mods! **The effects can't be removed using milk, commands or dying.**

# <center> CONFIG: </center>

Open **"in_effect-common.toml"** file in config folder and add any effect you want.

![Config file screenshot.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8c165cca753cf299f6da8cd1e7ad045b4e56e988.png)

- **permanent_effects:** list of effects, in this example, Speed III.
- **show_icon:** Enable or disable the effect toast in the screen corner.
- **show_particles:** i need to explain this?
- **ambient:** make particles a bit transparent.

# <center> BUGS?: </center>

Please report any bug or suggestion in my discord server or Curseforge comments. Thanks for use my mod!
